BLOCKING DEFECT FOUND: the scope claims 'retained_canonical_unchanged_except: [cinema-people-20261011, music-people-20261011]' (release-evidence.json) and the task text says 'only approved People changes' -- this is FALSE. Diffing all 296 files common to V1 and V2 stages (excluding checksums.txt, which differs only because the file manifest changed, as expected), 7 non-People files differ in content between V1 and V2, and V1 matches the pinned git source commit 42a2aaf exactly while V2 does NOT:
- next/content/home-alone-1-part-1/bundle.json: correct_option_id for question q-ha1-p1-7 changed from opt-3 (git/V1) to opt-1 (V2) -- an undisclosed, unapproved ANSWER-KEY CHANGE on a live quiz question, not a scope-trim operation. Also published_at silently rewritten (2026-09-20 -> 2026-10-11), bundle_version retagged to '2026.10.11.duplicates', and a new difficulty_level field added.
- next/content/theme-harry-potter/{bundle.json,draft.json}: option text for one choice changed, bundle_version/published_at rolled BACK to an older tag ('2026.10.10.hp006-r2' -> '2026.10.04.thematic80', date 10-10 -> 10-04) -- looks like a stale/reverted file, not the pinned source.
- next/content/theme-harry-potter/manifest.json: source_sha256 changed accordingly.
- next/content/cinema-encore-20261011/bundle.json, music-encore-20261011/bundle.json, planet-paradoxes-20261010/bundle.json: bundle_sha256/bundle_version changed to a '...duplicates' tag not present in the pinned commit; planet-paradoxes also has published_at shifted by 1 hour.

These 7 files are outside the declared People-only change scope, are not disclosed anywhere in release-evidence.json/root-package-scope-finding.json, and one of them silently changes a live correct-answer key. This is not a byte-level archive-packaging defect (the 53-file trim and archive mechanics are correct) -- it is undisclosed, unapproved content drift inside the 'retained unchanged' set, including an answer-key change that must not ship without its own review. Verdict: rework -- V2 must be re-staged from the exact pinned source for these 7 paths (or the home-alone key change must go through its own disclosed/approved review) before this package can be accepted. Not re-approving based on the prior V1 review, which did not cover this file-content drift since V1 itself matches source on these files.
